<tabber>Chapter I: Magnus Opus=

The first chapter, '''Magnus Opus''', runs from January 2, 2019.

== Synopsis ==
After the events of [[Shattered Fates]], [[New Quintessa]] isn't the same. The line between real and shattered Bots have blurred. Autobots now can't trust one another, and [[Ultra Magnus]]' return creates discontent within the ranks: is he good, or is he evil? [[Ratchet]] and [[Grimlock]] dives deeper into the coming conflict.

|-|Chapter II: Feast and Famine=
The second chapter, '''Feast and Famine''', runs from January 30, 2020.

== Synopsis ==
Amidst all this bickering, our Bots have forgotten the number one priority of any list:

'''Resource Management.'''

With resources depleting and threatening to starve, a rag-tag team of Movie Decepticons - [[Barricade]], [[Bonecrusher]] and [[Mixmaster]] - must search for food while fending off threats like arguing Autobots and dastardly Decepticons (those are the originals, not the Movie 'Cons).
